title: When People Are Cursed
text: When People Are Cursed by Abdullah Al-Baradouni You bemoan all, tired of never receiving eulogies except in the speeches of your enemies. And myself, O my heart, I cry from the deepest part of my eyes whether the tragedy is near or far. I have resolved to work hard to live rather than continue crying for other’s misfortunes all the time. When people are cursed, I become miserable with them. When I am doomed like them, I suffer with my misery alone! I seclude myself to reflect. Everybody is with me and my wealth. I do not need the material life, never have I had anything from it. The only happiness is in the darkest night and I am drained. I do not trek from place to place like a refugee only to feel punished, wearier. I am exhausted. I walk mindlessly with my feet. The sorrow is my food, the cold fever my clothing. The darkness is my mattress and my cover. My body is overheating, my veins, my skin.
